en-US.author: Artem Chepurnyi
en-US.description: An alternative client for the Bitwarden® platform
en-US.name: Keyguard
en-US.releaseNotes:
This release adds experimental P2P sync for app settings and using passkeys on another device on Android.
New
- Sync: Added experimental P2P sync for app settings.
- Android: Added using passkeys on another device.
Improvements
- Attachments: Dropping more than one file at once into the attachments box is now supported.
- Passkeys: Importing p256 passkeys from Proton Pass exports is now supported.
- SSH agent: Request logs older than a configured limit can now be removed automatically.
- SSH agent: Clicking request log items now opens a details dialog.
- Vault: Invalid TOTP raw values are now handled gracefully.
Security
- Backups: Vault exports and backups now support the more secure .zip.age format.
Fixes
- Android: Fixed "Unknown username" when logging in by passkey (#1669).
- Android: Fixed the Termux GPG agent failing to connect (#1664).
- iOS: Fixed the navigation bar covering the toolbar on iPad.
- iOS: Fixed the Type picker not opening in the Login editor's generator.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed a crash when opening Bitwarden 2FA or SSO screens.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed a crash when leaving GPG tools or the Generator with a screen open.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed picking a client certificate doing nothing.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed an account with a revoked session so it shows the Sign in button.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed nested folders so opening them opens the folder instead of their items.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed pasting a .env file into the import field so it keeps line breaks.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed the GPG generator's Custom date expiry row so it shows the chosen date.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed tag suggestions that differ only in case overlapping each other.
- iOS, macOS: Fixed the Lock after reboot option so it is hidden.
- Desktop: Fixed the request approval window so it shows toast messages.
- Backups: Fixed Bitwarden attachments so the correct plainSize is written.
- Generator: Fixed generating email aliases and GPG keys so it stops for inputs that show an error.
- Generator: Fixed wordlist inputs so HTML pages are refused and HTTP failures fail.
- KDBX: Fixed removing a group so it keeps previously deleted objects.
- SSH agent: Fixed the SSH Agent Request log badge overlapping with text (#1665).
- Vault: Fixed the Trash screen so it shows trashed archived items.
- Vault: Fixed importing so missing SSH key fingerprints are recovered from the source data.

zh-CN.description: Bitwarden® 平台的替代客户端
zh-CN.longDescription:
Keyguard 是 Bitwarden® 平台的替代客户端，旨在提供最佳的用户体验。
亮点：
- 美观丰富、反应灵敏的 Material You 用户界面；
- 强大而快速的搜索功能；
- 支持创建和使用 passkey--现代密码替代品。
- 可查找具有被破解密码、漏洞账户、重复使用的密码、不活动的双因素身份验证、不活动的 passkey、不安全的网站以及重复、不完整和过期等项目的哨兵；
- 多账户支持 🌠 支持安全登录和双因素身份验证；
- 添加项目 🌠 和发送 🌠、修改 🌠 并离线查看您的保险库；
- 导出个人或组织项目，包括附件；
- 漂亮的浅色/深色主题；
- 带有 SSH 密钥的生成器、电子邮件转发器、自定义词表支持等功能；
- 支持占位符和 URL 覆盖；
- 不仅于此！
🌠 - 在 Android 上需要高级一次性许可证或订阅许可证。
